kv-contract.title: Start with a known key
kv-contract.description: A client calls put or get with an exact key. The coordinator routes it to a value store. Filtering by a value field needs a separately maintained index.
kv-contract.note: The API contract also decides durability, size limits, and freshness.

kv-partition.title: Map a key to one owner
kv-partition.description: The coordinator hashes a key onto a ring. A key is assigned to its next clockwise owner. Virtual nodes spread ranges; adding a node transfers only its newly owned ranges.
kv-partition.note: A balanced number of keys does not imply balanced traffic.

kv-replication.title: Choose independent replica owners
kv-replication.description: A coordinator places one key on three distinct physical replicas across failure domains; virtual positions on the same machine are not separate safety copies.
kv-replication.note: Place copies for the failures you promise to survive.

kv-quorum.title: Count acknowledgments, then read responses
kv-quorum.description: With three fixed replicas, a write waits for two acknowledgments and a read waits for two responses. The sets intersect, but concurrency and changing membership need further semantics.
kv-quorum.note: W + R > N describes overlap only for the same stable replica set.

kv-conflicts.title: One parent, two concurrent children
kv-conflicts.description: Two writers read version v1. Their independent updates produce sibling versions v2a and v2b. Causal metadata detects the split; a domain merge creates v3.
kv-conflicts.note: A timestamp winner could silently discard a valid edit.

kv-failure.title: A substitute holds a temporary hint
kv-failure.description: Membership observations suspect preferred replica B is unavailable. The coordinator sends a temporary copy to substitute C, which hands it back when B recovers.
kv-failure.note: Hints help short outages; periodic repair handles longer divergence.

kv-repair.title: Compare hashes, then repair one range
kv-repair.description: Replica roots disagree. Matching left-side hashes are skipped while the differing right branch is inspected and its versioned keys repaired.
kv-repair.note: Retain deletion tombstones until stale replicas are safely repaired.

kv-paths.title: One node's write and read paths
kv-paths.description: A write is logged durably before acknowledgment, then held in memory and flushed to sorted tables. Reads consult memory and use Bloom filters to avoid impossible table lookups.
kv-paths.note: A Bloom filter's “maybe” still needs a real lookup.

kv-operations.title: Observe the failure promise
kv-operations.description: A node or region failure exercises routing, replica acknowledgments, hint backlog, repair lag, and the actual read freshness experienced by clients.
kv-operations.note: A healthy latency chart cannot prove replica convergence.
